sentiment.summary: Fear-driven market (44 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but stale congressional purchases (173+ days old) and weak conviction provide minimal confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (348.8) indicates extreme market fear, creating highly unfavourable conditions for technology equities.
